Name: StrawberryRecipes
Author: WhiteShu
Description:
关于本模组

白树的草莓食谱 是一套以草莓为主题的甜品食谱扩展包，基于 Content Patcher (CP) 框架运行。模组为游戏新增了 7 款 精致可爱的草莓甜品，每一款都配有独立的像素图标和游戏内描述，让你在星露谷的厨房里也能享受满满的草莓甜蜜！

本模组包含以下食谱：

· 🍦 草莓甜筒 — 清凉甜美的夏日必备
· 🎂 草莓蛋糕 — 经典松软的草莓奶油蛋糕
· 🍩 草莓甜甜圈 — 裹满草莓糖霜的甜甜圈
· 🧋 草莓奶茶 — 香醇奶茶搭配草莓果香
· 🧁 草莓马芬蛋糕 — 外酥内软的草莓马芬
· 🥧 草莓派 — 酸甜可口的经典草莓派
· 🍮 草莓布丁 — 入口即化的柔滑布丁

所有食谱均通过游戏内正常途径获取（可自行设定获取方式，如提升好感度后邮件获得、烹饪等级解锁等），完美融入原版游戏体验。

使用说明

1. 确保已安装 SMAPI 和 Content Patcher
2. 下载后将压缩包解压至 Stardew Valley/Mods 文件夹
3. 通过 SMAPI 启动游戏即可自动加载

前置需求

· SMAPI
· Content Patcher (CP)

本模组为纯内容扩展，不修改任何游戏原有机制，可随时安装或卸载。

English Description

Baishu's Strawberry Recipes — A Sweet Strawberry Dessert Collection

About This Mod

Baishu's Strawberry Recipes is a strawberry‑themed dessert recipe pack powered by the Content Patcher (CP) framework. This mod adds 7 adorable strawberry desserts to your Stardew Valley kitchen, each with its own custom pixel sprite and in‑game description — perfect for satisfying your sweet tooth on the farm!

This Mod Includes the Following Recipes:

· 🍦 Strawberry Ice Cream Cone — a cool and sweet summer treat
· 🎂 Strawberry Cake — a classic fluffy strawberry cream cake
· 🍩 Strawberry Donut — a donut coated in strawberry glaze
· 🧋 Strawberry Milk Tea — rich milk tea with a fruity strawberry twist
· 🧁 Strawberry Muffin — a soft and crumbly strawberry muffin
· 🥧 Strawberry Pie — a tangy and sweet classic strawberry pie
· 🍮 Strawberry Pudding — a silky smooth, melt‑in‑your‑mouth pudding

All recipes can be obtained through normal in‑game progression (you can customize the unlock method — e.g., received via mail after reaching certain friendship levels, or unlocked through cooking skill progression), blending seamlessly into the vanilla game experience.

How to Use

1. Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed
2. Download and extract the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
3. Launch the game with SMAPI — the mod will load automatically

Requirements

· SMAPI
· Content Patcher (CP)

This is a pure content expansion mod. It does not alter any vanilla game mechanics and can be safely added or removed at any time.
